def add_string(lst, fmt):

    return [fmt.format(i) for i in lst]

def add_string(lst, fmt):
    # Use list comprehension to concatenate format string with each element of the list
    return [fmt + str(i) for i in lst]

# Test the function with provided test case
assert add_string([1,2,3,4],'temp') == ['temp1', 'temp2', 'temp3', 'temp4']
